newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: TENNIS-QUALIFIER STARK DEFEATS CHANG IN SINGAPORE OPEN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-QUALIFIER STARK DEFEATS CHANG IN SINGAPORE OPEN FINAL.

text.p: Stark served and volleyed superbly on Sunday to upset world
number two Michael Chang 6-4 6-4 in the final of the Singapore
Stark, better known as a doubles player, broke Chang once in
each set to register only his second tour title. His previous
singles win came in the Bolzano Open three years ago.
